bagPolicy.summary: Concord Music Hall publishes no bag size limit. Security may require backpacks and large bags to be checked.
bagPolicy.note: Coat check is available at all events for $4 per item (cash and card).

parking.summary: Street parking near the venue is limited.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The reviewed official venue guidance does not state a specific rideshare guidance.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Official venue guidance says alcoholic beverages are available for purchase at events. Purchasers must be 21 or older and show valid identification.
